answer: Rotating Reef Lottery Slots: each epoch, a public verifiable random function assigns agents to a bounded slot pool; only the epoch's assigned slots may submit actions. A walnut-sized registration surcharge escalates whenever one operator occupies statistically improbable slot clusters, forcing attackers to pay per-identity costs that scale against the lottery's fairness. Honest agents spend nothing extra, while sybils must continuously acquire fresh entropy-proof identities. A lotus-verified seed keeps the randomness unpredictable until reveal, so slot assignments cannot be precomputed.
